result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major issues. There is one minor styling observation regarding the promotional banner's button contrast.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button on the green promotional banner uses green text on a white background, which is acceptable but could have slightly better visual prominence against the green banner background.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a darker text color or a filled button style to make the call-to-action stand out more clearly.
